args.message: Fixed Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test lane (April 12–May 17; 25 admitted): approved descriptive result—18 paid-active, $27,860 refund-adjusted collected cash, 33-minute median and 116-minute 90th-percentile account-level support effort, with 5/25 above 90 minutes; no additional Q3 paid batch was authorized; excluded claim categories: causal acquisition, support improvement, scale, revenue, pipeline, and forecast.
